sloka: स तेन तु तथा क्रोधात् काकुत्स्थेनार्दितो रणे ।रावणः समरश्लाघी महाक्रोधमुपागमत् ।। ६.१०५.१ ।।
transliteration: sa tena tu tathā krodhāt kākutsthenārdito raṇe ।rāvaṇaḥ samaraślāghī mahākrodhamupāgamat ।। 6.105.1 ।।

translations.english: Ravana, who was proud of his skill in warfare, became very angry when he was pained by Kakuthsa's arrows.
